description: Five trained 16-task bilinear attention models; flat 12-atom top-four autoencoder dictionary trained only on primitive+AND query activations. Eight overlapping binary groups learned by kmeans of unlabeled top-four supports from new primitive+AND sequences. Group inference selects one or two sets by head reconstruction error, then top-four atoms in their union; shared atoms decoded once. No XOR in fitting or selection. Size-4/6/8 groups; physical top-three/top-four, flat top-four baselines; independent uniform and shifted-token tests; finite single-key bit-toggle logit edit paths.
